f3_program: collection("magdalena.apple_tree.apples", "apple", "magdalena.apple_tree", source("it grew 200 apples"))
observe(at("magdalena.apple_tree.apples.count", "initial"), 200, "count", source("it grew 200 apples"))

remove("first_day_pick", "magdalena", at("magdalena.apple_tree.apples.count", "current"), fraction(at("magdalena.apple_tree.apples.count", "initial"), 1, 5), source("Magdalena picked 1/5 of the fruits on the first day"))
remove("second_day_pick", "magdalena", at("magdalena.apple_tree.apples.count", "current"), scale(event_field("first_day_pick", "quantity"), 2), source("twice that number on the second day"))
offset("magdalena.apple_tree.apples.picked.third_day.count", event_field("first_day_pick", "quantity"), 20, "count", source("20 more apples than he picked on the first day on the third day"))

remove("third_day_pick", "magdalena", at("magdalena.apple_tree.apples.count", "current"), "magdalena.apple_tree.apples.picked.third_day.count", source("20 more apples than he picked on the first day on the third day"))
query("remaining_count", "magdalena.apple_tree.apples", "current")
assumptions: The source's pronouns refer to Magdalena, and "the fruits" refers to the 200 apples on the tree.
The requested weekly increment requires converting 280 days into weeks using an unstated days-per-week conversion, which F3-v1 does not permit inventing.

f3_program: collection("gecko.three_day_crickets", "cricket", "gecko.three_day_cycle", source("70 crickets every three days"))
observe(at("gecko.three_day_crickets.count", "initial"), 70, "count", source("70 crickets every three days"))
observe(at("gecko.cricket_cycle.duration", "current"), 3, "day", source("every three days"))

consume("first_day_consumption", "gecko", at("gecko.three_day_crickets.count", "current"), fraction(at("gecko.three_day_crickets.count", "initial"), 30, 100), source("The first day she eats 30% of the crickets"))
offset("gecko.three_day_crickets.consumed.second_day.count", event_field("first_day_consumption", "quantity"), -6, "count", source("The second day she eats 6 less than the first"))

consume("second_day_consumption", "gecko", at("gecko.three_day_crickets.count", "current"), "gecko.three_day_crickets.consumed.second_day.count", source("The second day she eats 6 less than the first"))

consume("third_day_consumption", "gecko", at("gecko.three_day_crickets.count", "current"), at("gecko.three_day_crickets.count", "current"), source("the third day she finishes up the remaining crickets"))
query("value", event_field("third_day_consumption", "quantity"))
assumptions: The 70 crickets form the three-day batch subsequently referenced as "the crickets" and "the remaining crickets".

f3_program: collection("marcus.five_day_paintings", "painting", "five_day_period", source("On the first day, he paints 2 paintings"))
observe(at("marcus.painting_period.duration", "planned"), 5, "day", source("If he paints for 5 days"))
produce("day_1_painting", "marcus", at("marcus.five_day_paintings.count", "current"), 2, source("On the first day, he paints 2 paintings"))

produce("day_2_painting", "marcus", at("marcus.five_day_paintings.count", "current"), scale(event_field("day_1_painting", "quantity"), 2), source("each day, he paints twice as many paintings as he painted the day before"))

produce("day_3_painting", "marcus", at("marcus.five_day_paintings.count", "current"), scale(event_field("day_2_painting", "quantity"), 2), source("each day, he paints twice as many paintings as he painted the day before"))

produce("day_4_painting", "marcus", at("marcus.five_day_paintings.count", "current"), scale(event_field("day_3_painting", "quantity"), 2), source("each day, he paints twice as many paintings as he painted the day before"))

produce("day_5_painting", "marcus", at("marcus.five_day_paintings.count", "current"), scale(event_field("day_4_painting", "quantity"), 2), source("each day, he paints twice as many paintings as he painted the day before"))
query("value", at("marcus.five_day_paintings.count", "current"))
assumptions: The pronoun "he" refers to Marcus, and the stated daily recurrence applies through day 5.

f3_program: observe(at("uf.points.total", "previous_24_games"), 720, "point", source("a total of 720 points during their previous 24 games"))
observe(at("uf.games.count", "previous_24_games"), 24, "count", source("their previous 24 games"))

rate_relation(at("uf.points.total", "previous_24_games"), at("uf.points.per_game", "previous_24_games"), at("uf.games.count", "previous_24_games"), source("a total of 720 points during their previous 24 games"))

fraction_of(at("uf.points.half_previous_per_game", "championship_game"), at("uf.points.per_game", "previous_24_games"), 1, 2, source("half as much as they had previously scored in each of the 24 games"))

offset(at("uf.points", "championship_game"), at("uf.points.half_previous_per_game", "championship_game"), -2, "point", source("they scored 2 points less than half as much as they had previously scored in each of the 24 games"))
offset(at("uf.opponent.points", "championship_game"), at("uf.points", "championship_game"), -2, "point", source("Their opponent only lost by 2 points"))
query("value", at("uf.opponent.points", "championship_game"))
assumptions: The phrase describing what UF previously scored "in each" game refers to the per-game scoring rate implied by 720 total points across 24 games.
